User.title: User
User.description: Student profile registered on the Eduway educational platform.

nickname.description: The student's chosen cohort discussion name.

classCohort.description: The assigned class cohort, e.g. Wheeler 1 to Wheeler 4.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp indicating when the account record was created.

points.description: Cumulative Challenge Hub points earned by the student.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp indicating when the account record was last updated.

Submission.title: Submission
Submission.description: Academic Hub course, news article, useful website, or community question undergoing moderation or published.

id.description: Unique identifier of the submission document.

title.description: Title of the course, news item, website, or community question.

description.description: Detailed summary, question details, or description.

content.description: Extended body content for news summaries.

subject.description: Subject ID within General Hub or Specialized Hub.

websiteUrl.description: Clickable HTTP/HTTPS URL for useful website entries.

sourceUrl.description: Optional HTTP/HTTPS source link for news entries.

resourceFormat.description: Attachment format selected by the submitter.

submitterId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the author.

submitterName.description: Public display name of the author.

fileUrl.description: External HTTP/HTTPS reference link to the document, video, or resource.

reviewedBy.description: UID of the reviewing Owner authority.

reviewedAt.description: Timestamp when the review decision was reached.

decisionNote.description: Feedback or explanation accompanying the review decision.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the submission was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the submission was updated.

MemberRequest.title: MemberRequest
MemberRequest.description: Formal administrative inquiry, cohort transfer, or curriculum access request submitted by a student.

id.description: Unique identifier of the member request.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the requesting student.

userName.description: Full name of the requesting student.

subject.description: Brief headline or summary of the request.

details.description: Comprehensive explanation of the student's request.

decisionNote.description: Owner explanation or remarks regarding the decision.

reviewedAt.description: Timestamp when the request was processed.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the request was initiated.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Audit and submission alerts for the designated Owner.

id.description: Unique identifier of the notification (sub_{submissionId} for submissions).

submissionType.description: Submission type when type is submission.

submitterName.description: Public name of the submitting user.

submissionStatus.description: Current approval state of the linked submission.

isRead.description: Whether the alert has been acknowledged.

relatedId.description: Associated submission or request document ID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the alert was triggered.

Challenge.title: Challenge
Challenge.description: Educational challenge published by the Owner on Challenge Hub.

attachmentUrl.description: Optional HTTP/HTTPS resource or Google Drive URL.

ChallengeAnswer.title: ChallengeAnswer
ChallengeAnswer.description: Student-submitted answer awaiting or having received manual Owner review.

challengeTitle.description: Challenge Name at time of submission.

challengeSubject.description: Challenge Subject at time of submission.

studentId.description: Firebase Auth UID of submitting student.

ChallengeNotification.title: ChallengeNotification
ChallengeNotification.description: Student-scoped in-app notification for Challenge Hub answer review outcomes.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when notification was created.

ChallengeWinner.title: ChallengeWinner
ChallengeWinner.description: Verified winner record created atomically when Owner marks a challenge answer correct.

id.description: Winner record ID matching accepted answerId.

acceptedAt.description: Server timestamp when accepted by Owner.

PublicProfile.title: PublicProfile
PublicProfile.description: PII-free publicly shared student username, avatar URL, and skills for Explore Other Students' Skills.

id.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the student.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when public profile was updated.

StudentNotification.title: StudentNotification
StudentNotification.description: Student-only notification records for submission decisions, challenge reviews, points earned, and unlocked achievements.

userId.description: Recipient student Firebase Auth UID (never Owner).

itemTitle.description: Related course, resource, question, or challenge title.

targetPage.description: Target page route when notification is clicked.

relatedId.description: Related submission or challenge document ID.

isRead.description: Whether the student marked this notification as read.

/users/{userId}.description: User account document indexed by Firebase Auth UID.

/submissions/{submissionId}.description: Academic Hub submissions and approved public curriculum/news/websites/questions.

/requests/{requestId}.description: Administrative requests and inquiries submitted by platform members.

/notifications/{notificationId}.description: Owner-only notifications for new member submissions and administrative events.

/challenges/{challengeId}.description: Published Challenge Hub challenges created by the Owner.

/challengeAnswers/{answerId}.description: Student answer submissions and Owner review decisions.

/challengeNotifications/{notificationId}.description: Student-scoped Challenge Hub notifications for reviewed answers.

/challengeWinners/{winnerId}.description: Verified Challenge Hub winners created upon Owner approval.

/publicProfiles/{userId}.description: PII-isolated public student skills directory readable by authenticated students.

/studentNotifications/{notificationId}.description: Student-only notification center events (excluding the Owner account).
